questions.prompt: Why did Grumpy want to visit the Long Meadow?
choices: It had a peaceful flat rock.
It had a new cave to build.
questions.answer: It had a peaceful flat rock.
questions.evidenceText: There is a good flat rock there. Peaceful. No one around.

questions.prompt: How did Grumpy pull Chompy from the ditch?
questions.evidenceText: Grumpy's club tail lowered into the ditch. Chompy grabbed on. Grumpy pulled.

questions.prompt: What does Grumpy calling out about another bush show?
choices: Grumpy wanted Chompy to leave forever.
Grumpy had forgotten where Chompy was.
questions.rationale: Grumpy pulls Chompy from the ditch, shares the rock with him, and later points out another berry bush; these helpful choices and his slight smile show that Grumpy cares about Chompy's happiness.
questions.evidenceText: But after a while, Grumpy called: There is a good-looking bush to your left. Thanks, Grumpy! said Chompy. Grumpy said nothing. But the corner of the mouth went up. Just slightly.

supportingEvidence.evidenceText: Grumpy pulled. Chompy came out covered in mud.
They sat on the rock together. Less peaceful with Chompy. But not actually terrible.
